calculation.description: For each tradable benchmark, remove its rolling 20-session beta exposure to the universe median daily return, then favor negative residual moves scaled by residual volatility. The signal is computed using completed bars only and forecasts next-session return.

validation.regime_notes: Daily signal passes benchmark admission thresholds; ICIR is modest and uncertainty is material in a 15-instrument universe. Daily effect was positive across 2020-22, 2023-24, and 2025-26. Longer holding horizons reverse sharply, so use only for short-horizon rebalance timing.
